newsitem.title: FRANCE: Currencies positive for PSA results.
newsitem.headline: Currencies positive for PSA results.

text.p: The rise in the Italian lira and British pound had a positive impact on the 1996 results of French carmaker PSA Peugeot Citroen and the effect should be positive also this year, chairman Jacques Calvet said on Thursday.

Currency shifts, which had a negative 3.6 billion franc impact at the pre-tax operating level in 1995, had a "slight" positive impact of 150 million francs last year, Calvet told a news conference. "If the recent improvements continue, it would have a positive effect...in 1997," he said.
On the other hand, environmental norms added 1.1 billion francs to costs, he said.
